svg.title: RAGForge architecture and public demo boundary
svg.desc: A trusted API and CLI ingest documents into a private runtime. The public browser reaches a separate sample-only read-only demo through a temporary HTTPS tunnel. Each runtime owns separate SQLite, Qdrant and BM25 stores. Retrieval fuses dense and lexical ranks, optionally reranks, and returns cited evidence before optional generation.
